commentary_title: US loadings affected by Hurricane Beryl
commentary_summary: US LPG prices increased despite the inventory build-up due to hurricane Beryl affecting vessel movement in US Gulf | A narrowing US-Asia price arbitrage weighed on the fixing activity impacting the spot rates | VLGC spot rates on the AG-Japan and US-Japan routes each declined 7% WoW, averaging $69.2 per tonne and $109.1 per tonne respectively. | Asian demand to be impacted by the arrival of monsoon and dismal PDH margins in China
